notes: Final amendment (Amendment No. 1) to an issuer tender offer. fund_type: the filing calls the issuer an 'externally managed, non-diversified, closed-end management investment company' with no public market for its shares; it does not say BDC in this excerpt, so closed_end_fund was used (interval_or_tender_offer_fund is also plausible). price_pct_nav: the filing states the price was the NAV per share (not a stated percent); 100 records 'equal to NAV'. Offer size is the lesser of (i) shares repurchasable with 90% of DRIP proceeds from the November 1, 2024 dividend and (ii) 2.5% of the weighted average shares outstanding in the prior four quarters; 2.5 is recorded as size_pct_outstanding although it is of the weighted average, not current outstanding. commencement_date taken from the date of the Offer to Purchase (September 26, 2024; original Schedule TO filed the same day); the filing does not say 'commenced'. proration_factor_pct not stated (would need arithmetic, 512,730 / 5,919,194, and odd-lot priority shares are excluded from proration). Aggregate purchase price $3,968,531.78. Offer conditions are not stated in this amendment. No ticker: the filing says there is no public market for the Shares.
